title: Example 145: the same declaration at --max-array-length 12, the bisection proved unchanged on tables of nine to twelve pairs (own checker)
description: Regression proof of Mica's LookupSwitch#find with a linear scan for tables of at most eight pairs, scoped with --unchanged-unless 'matches.length <= 8' and approach.maxArrayLength 12 (the new field, passed as --max-array-length): the domain holds tables of nine to twelve pairs, which the scope admits, and the tool's own checker proves the bisection unchanged on every such table and every key. Expected: verified, not vacuous (the probe is refuted on a nine-pair table). Measured 4.1 s, 85 MB, 89 paths, 548 solver calls.
